People are still buying stuff, just not in the malls. They have it delivered instead, a trend that has been growing for years already. The big box stores remain open as well, and they are all steady. More people now work online instead of going in to work. Traffic is busy again. There is still an economy that is very much alive.

Panicked governments are flooding the system with cash to reduce the impact of sudden changes. Without this, the situation would be dramatically worse. Hyper inflation has not occurred, and neither has hyper deflation. Global shipping has returned largely to the previous levels in 2019. Job growth has resumed, and the employment numbers have been much better than had been hoped for.

Families are spending the most time together than perhaps since the great depression. There are many such silver linings in the clouds.
